banner.title: We value your privacy
banner.text: We use cookies to keep the site working, remember your preferences, and understand how visitors use our site. You can accept all cookies, reject optional ones, or manage your preferences in detail.

modal.title: Cookie Preferences
modal.intro: Choose which categories of cookies we're allowed to use. Strictly necessary cookies are always active because the site cannot function properly without them. You can change your preferences at any time from the "Cookie Settings" link in the footer.

necessary.title: Strictly Necessary Cookies
necessary.description: Required for core site functionality such as security, network management, and accessibility. These cannot be switched off.

functional.title: Functional Cookies
functional.description: Remember your preferences — such as language and display settings — to give you a more personalized experience.

analytics.title: Analytics Cookies
analytics.description: Help us understand how visitors interact with our site (e.g. Google Analytics, Hotjar) so we can improve performance and content.

marketing.title: Marketing Cookies
marketing.description: Used to deliver relevant ads, measure campaign performance, and power retargeting and tracking pixels across other sites.

doNotSell.title: Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information
doNotSell.description: California residents can opt out of the sale or sharing of personal information for cross-context behavioral advertising. Enabling this disables marketing cookies.
